title: Check: Introduction to Rates of Reaction (2)

questions.stem: Which of the following is NOT a factor that affects the rate of a chemical reaction?
questions.explanation: The colour of the reactants does not affect the rate of a chemical reaction. The main factors that affect reaction rate are concentration, temperature, surface area, presence of a catalyst, and pressure (for gases).

questions.stem: How does the rate of a reaction typically change as the reaction progresses?

options.text: It stays constant throughout the reaction
It increases steadily until the reaction is complete
It is fastest at the start and slows down as reactants are used up
It is slowest at the start and speeds up over time

questions.explanation: The rate of reaction is typically fastest at the start because the concentration of reactants is highest. As reactants are consumed, there are fewer particles to collide, so the rate slows down. The reaction eventually stops when the limiting reactant is completely used up.
